Hi Alex —

I noticed your team has been ramping up usage in the self-serve account this month (nice work!) and you crossed the thresholds we use for recommending a quick walkthrough. Happy to run a 30-minute prompted demo to show how you can reduce cost-per-token with batching and the quick integration patterns for streaming and function calls.

If that sounds useful, here are a few slots I have next week:
- Thu 6/17, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu 6/17, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Tue 6/22, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Or pick a time here: https://cal.com/redwood/jordan-30

Agenda (quick):
- 5m intros
- 15m targeted demo: cost/latency config + batching examples
- 10m Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

I can loop in Camila (AE) for next steps if it looks like a fit. Let me know which slot works and I’ll send an invite.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
